payload.body: Shipped S3BlobBytesDriver behind the BlobBytesDriver seam (3rd driver after sqlite/filesystem). Tenant-isolated content-addressed keys; optional @aws-sdk/client-s3 lazily imported by createS3BlobBytesDriver via a small injected S3LikeClient (mirrors RedisClusterBus). Config FRICK_BLOB_DRIVER=s3 + FRICK_BLOB_S3_BUCKET/_REGION/_ENDPOINT/_PREFIX. Built by caller + injected via createFrickServer({ blobBytesDriver }) since the SDK import is async. SQLite stays default; fully additive. Gate green: typecheck exit 0, server vitest 867 passed/45 skipped/0 failed.
